title: 建立 MC Plan 主会话统筹 Skill
objective: 建立 mc-plan-orchestrator 权威 Skill，使主会话能够从 Foundation 实时状态生成跨 Codex、ChatGPT Work、Codely/GLM 和其他代理可执行的派工提示词，核对多仓进度，恢复未完成工作流，并规划不冲突的后续开发顺序。
in_scope: 定义统筹 Skill 与 mc-plan-development 实施 Skill 的职责边界和组合方式
建立简短目标到完整派工提示词的生成协议，并适配 Codex、ChatGPT Work、Codely/GLM 和通用文件/Git 代理
建立基于实时 Git、当前方向、活动锁、状态页和验证证据的进度核对、异常恢复与后续路线协议
提供简要需求模板、静态行为评测、UI 元数据和确定性用户级安装脚本
更新 Foundation 的 Skill 索引与协调说明，并安装验证用户级副本
out_of_scope: 修改任何产品 HTTP API、JSON Schema、事件、SDK 或业务实现
修改 Contracts、Core、Community、Skin 或 Ops 仓库
替代活动工作流记录、自动解除仓库锁或绕过用户授权向其他会话发送消息
创建远程仓库、推送、部署、写入生产密钥或生产配置
contract_impact: none; Foundation-only orchestration Skill and documentation
acceptance_evidence: mc-plan-orchestrator has a concise entrypoint and focused references for dispatch prompts, progress recovery, and portfolio planning
a short user brief can be expanded into a current-state-aware prompt without granting authority beyond the user request
the Skill distinguishes implementation complete, workflow complete, merged, and product complete states using repository evidence
behavior cases cover lock conflicts, stale blockers, dirty repositories, safe concurrency, external agents, future modules, and read-only status requests
official Skill validation, deterministic install/check/replace tests, workspace validation, and coordination tests pass

direction_exception.authorized_by: MC Plan project owner via explicit request to create a main-session orchestration Skill for prompt generation, progress coordination, incomplete-work recovery, and future planning (2026-10-02)
direction_exception.reason: Foundation governance maintenance that enables bounded coordination while preserving mc-plan-core as the F1 primary product direction.
